# Karen Pearson

> Philosopher, author, and artist on Decatur Island in the Salish Sea, Washington.
> Her work identifies the linguistic and cognitive structures people operate from
> but rarely see, so that authorship of one's own life becomes possible.

Karen Pearson taught English and Literature at the College of Southern Nevada
through the 2000s while pursuing predoctoral studies. She now writes and works
from Decatur Island, which is reachable only by boat or small plane.

The work is not advice and not motivation. It identifies structure. It does not
prescribe behavior or manage the occupants.

## The Writing
- [The Writing](https://karenpearson.live/blog): 37 essays, October 22, 2026
  to July 1, 2026. Each isolates one pattern and traces it back to
  the language producing it.

## Core ideas
- Responsibility: the source of all is the self, blame is ignorance, and the
  choice to respond is life's only purpose.
- Language authors behavior. A life is a symptom of the language inside it.
- Forgiveness presupposes blame. Without blame there is nothing to forgive.
- Generosity begins as the way a person relates to themselves.
